negative_reviews.author: Suelen Mathias Borges
negative_reviews.text:
Unfortunately, we didn’t even get the chance to try the food, so I can’t comment on that. However, the customer service was the worst I’ve ever experienced.

From what I saw in the two minutes we were there, it’s a beautiful venue in a great location. We decided to visit after seeing it advertised and my partner purchased a Groupon voucher, as neither of us had been there before.

When we arrived, we immediately told the receptionist that we had a Groupon voucher. She welcomed us, did a big show with a drum showed us to a table, and said everything was fine. A few moments later, another member of staff came over and told us we couldn’t use the Groupon voucher on weekends, that could be totally avoided.

The frustrating part is that this restriction wasn’t made clear on Groupon, and if weekends weren’t eligible, the receptionist should have told us before seating us. Instead, we were seated, which was embarrassing and completely avoidable.

The restaurant looks lovely, and although the menu apparently nice, we were happy to give it a try. Sadly, the poor customer service completely changed our impression.

Losing two customers means losing much more than that. We won’t be returning, and unfortunately we can’t recommend the restaurant to our friends, family, or clients. A simple apology doesn’t make up for being treated so dismissively.

I hope the management takes this feedback on board and invests in better staff training and clearer communication regarding promotional offers. This experience wasn’t just about the Groupon voucher, it was about how we were treated.

negative_reviews.author: Y.K W
negative_reviews.text: The food and environment were good. However, it seemed that the waiters were not very welcoming towards Asian customers, even though they themselves were Asian. We felt that there was a different attitude in the way we were treated compared with local customers.
